data: What are the models compared in this figure?

The models compared in this figure are:

1. R2L (Linear)
2. R2R (Quadratic)
3. CNN+ATT
4. Hoffmann
5. PCNN+ATT
6. MIMLRE
7. Mintz

These models are represented by different colored lines on the graph. The caption explicitly mentions these models in the context of comparing their performance in relation extraction from the NYT corpus.
